name: When should I consider repairing my sliding door versus replacing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing my sliding door versus replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and replacement depends on the severity and nature of the problem. Minor issues like worn rollers, dirty tracks, or minor alignment problems are often cost-effectively repaired. However, if the door frame is extensively damaged, the glass is cracked beyond repair, or the door unit is very old and inefficient, replacement might be a better long-term investment. Consider the overall condition, energy efficiency, and security of the door. A professional assessment can help determine the most economical and practical solution for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair is suitable for minor issues like rollers or tracks; replacement is better for extensive damage, old, inefficient units, or security concerns.
